Container.Name: n8n
Container.Overview:
n8n workflow automation, using the official n8nio/n8n image without changes. All settings are n8n's own defaults. Community template, not affiliated with n8n.
SQLite is used, no separate database needed.
The container runs as Unraid's default user (99:100), so appdata and your shares work without chown. This is set in Extra Parameters together with the advanced variables HOME and N8N_USER_FOLDER.
Sign-in over plain HTTP: browsers reject n8n's default secure cookie. Set N8N_SECURE_COOKIE to false for LAN access without HTTPS.
Your own shares: fill in an Extra Path. The Read/Write Files node may use the Extra Paths, n8n's file protection stays on. Code nodes also need NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=fs,path.
Updates: stable follows n8n's newest stable release, including major versions. To stay on one version, use a fixed tag such as n8nio/n8n:2.45.7.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database, encryption key and installed community nodes. Keep this folder in your backups.

Config.Name: GENERIC_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: Time zone for schedule triggers. n8n default: America/New_York. Set your own, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: N8N_SECURE_COOKIE
Config.Description: n8n default: true. Set to false to sign in over plain HTTP.

Config.Name: N8N_WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Public URL with trailing slash, needed behind a reverse proxy or tunnel.

Config.Name: Extra Path 1
Config.Description: Optional. A share or folder for your workflows.

Config.Name: Extra Path 2
Config.Description: Optional. A share or folder for your workflows.

Config.Name: Extra Path 3
Config.Description: Optional. A share or folder for your workflows.

Config.Name: N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO
Config.Description: Container paths the Read/Write Files node may use, separated by semicolons. Do not leave empty: an empty value turns n8n's file protection off.

Config.Name: NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN
Config.Description: Optional. Node modules allowed in Code nodes, e.g. fs,path

Config.Name: N8N_USER_FOLDER
Config.Description: Required for running as 99:100. Do not change.

Config.Name: HOME
Config.Description: Required for running as 99:100, used to install community nodes. Do not change.
